title: Locally of finite type is checked on one affine pair around each point (Stacks 01T1 and 01T2)
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Then $f$ is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] if and only if for every $x\in X$ there exist an affine open $U\subseteq X$ with $x\in U$ and an affine open $V\subseteq S$ with $f(U)\subseteq V$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] such that the ring map $\mathcal O_S(V)\to\mathcal O_X(U)$ induced by $f$ is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], i.e. $\mathcal O_X(U)$ is a finitely generated $\mathcal O_S(V)$-algebra.
